semantic.justification: Task76 in progress: original clipboard ResetClip/InitClipPtrs and SharePooledResources retain genuine pool/string/attribute helper identities,source option values and sparse selected-sheet indexes. Clear releases actual formula and attribute owners before sheet removal. Native column4 CloneFormulaCell creates shared code once per shareable span,bulk-inserts actual typed storage and joins boundaries. Default CONTENTS CopyFromClipContext retains native cursor caches,cell values,metadata and deferred listening spans;single-cell column replication handles represented values,strings,empty and grouped formulas. Original temporary/inserting document guards suppress premature subscriptions and broadcasts. No browser fill loop,formula-text reparse,alternate workbook or simulated physical refcount is introduced. Document-level paste/reference completion,real paste undo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance are still pending;this progress record does not certify task76 or full native parity. Task76 pre-paste deletion progress ports SingleColumnSpanSet set/getSpans/swap/empty and the ColumnSpanSet single-column overload;native DeleteCells captures actual formula group extents before shared-context teardown and explicit broadcaster purge,then splits top/bottom boundaries and empties real typed stores in reverse span order. Original document10/table7/column4 pre-deletion cycles sparse source tabs and columns,visits allocated destinations only,and defers broadcasts/listener restoration to CopyFromClipContext. Default CONTENTS preserves destination patterns. Native toSpanArray is reused. Selective date/number deletion requires the unported formatter;skip-empty,nondefault flags and absent rich-edit/note/sparkline stores remain explicit. CellStorageModified formula-group compute cache and stream-valid notifications are unrepresented rather than simulated. Full document copy/paste/reference completion,paste Undo/Redo,EnterBlock and browser acceptance remain pending;this is not task76 completion or full parity. These additions supersede only earlier omissions of these specific pre-deletion/span/listener methods;unconsumed overloads and broader parity remain unverified. Task76 clone-copy progress: Original native delayed-listening map preserves existing pending intervals under nested enable calls,accepts overlap/adjacency and rejects disjoint spans unchanged;finish restores actual formula/group subscriptions before map erasure. TaskKVGGCR document-copy listening: Native EnableDelayDeletingBroadcasters preserves the equal-state early return and flushes actual populated sheets only when disabling. StartAllListeners skips clip/undo/no-listening owners,shares Start/EndListeningContext cursors and visits existing sheets in the original inclusive range.
